ECI Announces By-Elections for Six Assembly Seats

The Election Commission of India (ECI) has announced by-elections for six assembly seats across Bihar, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh. Voting is scheduled to take place on July 30. The notification covers seats in these three states, with West Bengal also mentioned in one report.
